# The script of testdata/cookiejar (P564) and of scripts/cookie_oracle.go: one command a line.
#   set URL HEADER   a Set-Cookie header of a response to URL
#   get URL          the Cookie header a request to URL carries
#   count            how many cookies the jar holds
#   clear            an empty jar
#   ! ...            a line Go's jar does not take part in (its clock cannot be set, it has no limits)
# ---- the basics (Go's jar_test.go, basicsTests) ----
set http://www.host.test/ A=a
get http://www.host.test/
set http://www.host.test/ A=a2
get http://www.host.test/
set http://www.host.test/ B=b
get http://www.host.test/
get http://other.test/
count
clear
# ---- paths (5.1.4) ----
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x P=root; Path=/
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x Q=foo; Path=/foo
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x R=default
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x S=slash; Path=/foo/
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x T=deep; Path=/foo/bar/baz
set http://www.host.test/foo/bar/x U=nopath; Path=nope
get http://www.host.test/
get http://www.host.test/foo
get http://www.host.test/foobar
get http://www.host.test/foo/
get http://www.host.test/foo/bar
get http://www.host.test/foo/bar/
get http://www.host.test/foo/bar/baz
get http://www.host.test/foo/bar/bazel
clear
# ---- domains (5.1.3, 5.2.3, 5.3) ----
set http://www.host.test/ H=hostonly
set http://www.host.test/ D=domain; Domain=host.test
set http://www.host.test/ L=leadingdot; Domain=.host.test
set http://www.host.test/ U=upper; Domain=WWW.Host.Test
set http://www.host.test/ X=other; Domain=other.test
! set http://www.host.test/ Y=super; Domain=test
set http://www.host.test/ Z=sub; Domain=sub.www.host.test
set http://www.host.test/ E=empty; Domain=
set http://www.host.test/ T=trailing; Domain=host.test.
set http://www.host.test/ W=dots; Domain=..host.test
get http://www.host.test/
get http://host.test/
get http://sub.www.host.test/
get http://other.test/
get http://www.host.test./
get http://WWW.HOST.TEST/
count
clear
# ---- addresses ----
set http://127.0.0.1/ A=ip
set http://127.0.0.1/ B=ipdomain; Domain=127.0.0.1
set http://127.0.0.1/ C=ipdot; Domain=.127.0.0.1
set http://127.0.0.1/ D=ipother; Domain=127.0.0.2
get http://127.0.0.1/
get http://127.0.0.2/
clear
# ---- secure ----
set https://www.host.test/ S=secure; Secure
set https://www.host.test/ P=plain
get https://www.host.test/
get http://www.host.test/
set https://localhost/ L=local; Secure
get http://localhost/
set https://sub.localhost/ M=sublocal; Secure
get http://sub.localhost/
set https://127.0.0.1/ N=loop; Secure
get http://127.0.0.1/
clear
# ---- expiry (5.2.1, 5.2.2, 5.3) ----
set http://www.host.test/ A=keep; Max-Age=3600
set http://www.host.test/ B=gone; Max-Age=0
set http://www.host.test/ C=gone; Max-Age=-1
set http://www.host.test/ D=odd; Max-Age=007
set http://www.host.test/ E=future; Expires=Fri, 31 Dec 2999 23:59:59 GMT
set http://www.host.test/ F=past; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT
set http://www.host.test/ G=badexpires; Expires=not a date
set http://www.host.test/ H=both; Max-Age=3600; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT
set http://www.host.test/ I=dashes; Expires=Fri, 31-Dec-2999 23:59:59 GMT
get http://www.host.test/
set http://www.host.test/ A=deleted; Max-Age=0
get http://www.host.test/
count
clear
# ---- the header's form (4.1.1, Go's ParseSetCookie) ----
set http://www.host.test/ V=value with spaces
set http://www.host.test/ W=a,b
set http://www.host.test/ Q="quoted"
set http://www.host.test/ E=
set http://www.host.test/ =novalue
set http://www.host.test/ bad name=x
set http://www.host.test/ Bad=va;lue
set http://www.host.test/ Bad="half
set http://www.host.test/ Bad=back\slash
set http://www.host.test/ Tab=x; Path=/; Secure=yes; HttpOnly=no; Unknown=1; SameSite=Strict
set http://www.host.test/ CI=case; PATH=/; sEcUrE
set http://www.host.test/  Spaced = s ; Path = /
set http://www.host.test/ Last=x; Path=/a; Path=/
set http://www.host.test/ Quote=x; Path="/q"
set http://www.host.test/ nothing
set http://www.host.test/
get http://www.host.test/
get https://www.host.test/
count
clear
# ---- replacement keeps the order of creation (5.3 step 11.3, 5.4 step 2) ----
set http://www.host.test/ A=1
set http://www.host.test/ B=2
set http://www.host.test/ A=3
set http://www.host.test/ C=4; Path=/x
get http://www.host.test/x/y
clear
# ---- more of the header and the hosts (Go takes part; the bracketed IPv6 host is ours alone: Go keeps the brackets and refuses it) ----
set http://www.host.test/ 	Tabbed=t	; Path=/
set http://www.host.test/ A=end\
set http://www.host.test/ B=x"
set http://www.host.test/ C=1;Path=/x
set http://nopath.test D=d
! set http://[::1]/ E=v6; Domain=::1
! set http://[::1]/ F=v6dot; Domain=.::1
set http://1.2.3.x/ G=notip; Domain=1.2.3.x
set http://www.host.test/ H=idn; Domain=host.tesÅ¥
set http://www.host.test/ Z=z; Path=/;Secure
get http://www.host.test/
get http://www.host.test/x/y
get http://www.host.test/other
get http://nopath.test/any
! get http://[::1]/
get http://sub.1.2.3.x/
clear
# ---- the limits (6.1), the clock and the tolerant dates (5.1.1): the standard's, beyond Go's jar ----
! set http://many.test/ fill=50
! get http://many.test/
! count
! clear
! set http://www.host.test/ A=tolerant; Expires=Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT
! set http://www.host.test/ B=tolerant2; Expires=Sunday, 06-Nov-94 08:49:37 GMT
! set http://www.host.test/ C=tolerant3; Expires=Sun Nov  6 08:49:37 1994
! set http://www.host.test/ D=tolerant4; Expires=06 Nov 2999 08:49:37
! set http://www.host.test/ E=tolerant5; Expires=2999-11-06 08:49:37
! set http://www.host.test/ F=tolerant6; Expires=06 Nov 1600 08:49:37
! set http://www.host.test/ G=tolerant7; Expires=31 Feb 2999 08:49:37
! set http://www.host.test/ H=tolerant8; Expires=06 Nov 2999 24:00:00
! set http://www.host.test/ I=tolerant9; Expires=6 nov 99 8:9:7
! set http://www.host.test/ J=tolerant10; Expires=Wed, 09 Jun 2021 10:18:14 GMT
! get http://www.host.test/
! count
! clear
! clear

! get http://clock.test/p
! count
! set http://clock.test/ A=again; Max-Age=5
! dump
! clear
# 6.1: the least recently used go first; a cookie that was read outlives the ones that were not
! now 1000
! set http://lru.test/ A=1; Path=/a
! set http://lru.test/ B=2
! now 2000
! get http://lru.test/b
! now 3000
! set http://lru.test/deep/ fill=50
! get http://lru.test/
! get http://lru.test/a
! count
! clear

! count
